title.narrative: Lifesaving severe acute malnutrition treatment services for children under five and pregnant and lactating mothers in flood affected population

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to enhance equitable access to integrated lifesaving nutrition services for children under five and pregnant and lactating women in flood-hit districts including Jhal Magsi, Kachhi, Dadu, and Qambar Shahdadkot. This UNICEF project will establish 50 outpatient nutrition sites, procure nutrition commodities, and conduct door-to-door screening programs among other activities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 410,400 people, including 1,800 men, 236,380 women, and 172,220 children, and 2,504 and persons with disabilities.
